capabilities: Search radio stations via the radio-browser.info API by name, country, language, and tag
Preview, favorite, and reorder stations in a right-sidebar player
Play, pause, and skip stations with volume control and ICY track metadata
Add custom stations not in the catalog
Run configurable Pomodoro focus sessions with breaks and audio cues
disambiguation: Despite the name, it streams internet radio rather than playing local audio files; the Pomodoro timer is an optional add-on.
extras: Desktop-only (Windows, macOS, Linux); mobile not supported. Search depends on the third-party radio-browser.info service, which is occasionally unavailable. The README discloses network usage and states the plugin requires no account, payment, or telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to listen to web radio or run focus sessions without leaving the app.
summary: Sidebar web radio player that searches radio-browser.info stations, saves favorites, and includes a customizable Pomodoro focus timer.
